# Honora Hollis

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c15 P0](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0000)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher and college student  <sub>[v1 c17 P0](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0000), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v3 c1 P5](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0005)</sub>
- **Titles:** Freshette  <sub>[v3 c4 P0](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0000)</sub>; Sophomore  <sub>[v3 c9 P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007)</sub>; Senior  <sub>[v3 c37 P16](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0016)</sub>

## Appearance

Honora is a tall, fair-haired girl with light, ethereal hair. She is taller than most of her peers, exceeding Cressida Lindsay by two inches.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P0](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0000), [v3 c4 P0](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0000), [v3 c4 P8](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0008)_

## Personality

Honora is thoughtful, imaginative, and possesses a sharp, subtle sense of humor. Despite her ethereal appearance, she is thoroughly packed with mischief, jokes, and fun. She values deep, sincere friendships and holds a high, romantic standard for companionship. She approaches her studies with earnest ambition and dedication, while maintaining a reflective, poetic outlook on life.

_Sources: [v1 c21 P6](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0006), [v1 c26 P0](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0000), [v1 c26 P3](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0003), [v3 c4 P46](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0046), [v3 c37 P23](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0023)_

## History

Honora attended Regent's Academy with Nell Harcourt and Mabel Colby, earning her place in the upper forms and developing a close friendship with Nell. After completing her studies at Regent's, she taught at the Delford school. During her time teaching, she participated in local community activities and supported Nell's efforts with the Brierley Village Improvement Society. Later, she decided to pursue higher education at Wexcombe College, entering as a Freshman alongside Nell and Hugh Carrow. At Wexcombe, she formed a close-knit group with Nell, Cressida Lindsay, and Mabel Colby, eventually renting and living together at the historic house 'Tabby's Place' under the care of Aunt Euphemia. Honora excelled academically, eventually earning Honors in Classics upon graduation. Throughout her college years, she shared in her friends' various romantic and literary endeavors, remaining a steadfast and thoughtful companion.

_Sources: [v1 c17 P0](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0000), [v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037), [v2 c6 P7](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0007), [v3 c1 P5](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0005), [v3 c4 P0](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0000), [v3 c4 P46](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0046), [v3 c9 P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007), [v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 c10 P1](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0001), [v3 c37 P29](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0029)_
